cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(arcade_ui VERSION 0.2.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)
add_library(arcade_ui STATIC src/core/layout.cpp src/core/host.cpp src/core/text_edit.cpp
    src/core/components.cpp src/core/canvas.cpp src/win32/text_engine.cpp)
add_library(arcade_ui::arcade_ui ALIAS arcade_ui)
target_sources(arcade_ui PUBLIC FILE_SET modules TYPE CXX_MODULES BASE_DIRS modules FILES modules/arcade_ui.cppm)
add_library(arcade_ui_dx12 STATIC src/dx12/ui_renderer.cpp)
add_library(arcade_ui::dx12 ALIAS arcade_ui_dx12)
set_target_properties(arcade_ui_dx12 PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME dx12)
target_sources(arcade_ui_dx12 PUBLIC FILE_SET modules TYPE CXX_MODULES BASE_DIRS modules FILES modules/arcade_ui_dx12.cppm)
add_library(arcade_ui_win32 STATIC)
add_library(arcade_ui::win32 ALIAS arcade_ui_win32)
set_target_properties(arcade_ui_win32 PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME win32)
target_sources(arcade_ui_win32 PUBLIC FILE_SET modules TYPE CXX_MODULES BASE_DIRS modules FILES modules/arcade_ui_win32.cppm)
target_link_libraries(arcade_ui_win32 PUBLIC arcade_ui PRIVATE imm32)
target_link_libraries(arcade_ui PRIVATE dwrite user32)
target_link_libraries(arcade_ui_dx12 PUBLIC arcade_ui PRIVATE d3d12 d3dcompiler d2d1 dwrite windowscodecs ole32)
foreach(target arcade_ui arcade_ui_dx12 arcade_ui_win32)
    target_compile_features(${target} PUBLIC cxx_std_23)
    target_include_directories(${target} PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}>)
    target_compile_definitions(${target} PUBLIC NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(${target} PUBLIC /utf-8 /Zc:__cplusplus PRIVATE /W4 /permissive-)
    endif()
endforeach()
install(TARGETS arcade_ui arcade_ui_dx12 arcade_ui_win32
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/$<CONFIG>
    FILE_SET modules DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/arcade_ui/modules)
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
configure_package_config_file(../cmake/arcade_uiConfig.cmake.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/arcade_uiConfig.cmake INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/arcade_ui)
write_basic_package_version_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/arcade_uiConfigVersion.cmake VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION} COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/arcade_uiConfig.cmake ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/arcade_uiConfigVersion.cmake DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/arcade_ui)
